石雷那行断了，指下还剩三个名字。: Shi Lei's line is broken. Three names under my fingers.
摸过这记新劈的深槽，眼底那捧沸灰才算凉透。: My hand finds the new gouge. At last the ash in my eyes is cold.
刀入青石三寸，字碎。石雷，这一笔销了。: Steel bites three inches into stone. Shi Lei, your debt is paid.
（风雪灌入破庙，刘白停在石阶下，侧耳听着殿内）: (Snow blows into the ruined temple. Liu Bai stops below the steps and listens.)
哪来的白毛小瞎子，敢闯本帅的庙？: What white-haired little blind rat dares enter my temple?
你腰里的刀，姓文。: The blade at your hip bears the Wen name.
汝南寒山坞文家？！哈，风箱底下那没死透的丫头？: The Wen family of Hanshan, Runan?! Ha! The girl under the bellows lived?
那夜把你爹钉在铁砧上，倒忘了把你一块儿填进炉里！: I nailed your father to the anvil. Should've thrown you in the furnace too!
七年不见，怎么吓得一头青丝全白了？: Seven years. Did fright turn all that black hair white?
（刘白拇指顶开刀镡，刀身发出一声低沉铁啸）: (Liu Bai thumbs her blade loose. The steel hums.)
（刘白呕出一口鲜血，颤抖的指尖在雪泥里死死够向刀柄）: (Liu Bai spits blood and claws through the slush for her blade.)
七年，就练成这样？: Seven years. Is that all you've learned?
烂在雪里吧，省得脏了老子的杖。: Rot in the snow. My staff's filthy enough.
官军跟黄巾贼杀红了眼，倒叫俺老杜捡了便宜。: The troops and the Yellow Turbans went at it. And Du Wu gets the pickings.
这鬼天，死人脚脖子冻得跟生铁似的，破鞋都扒不下来。: Damn this cold. Dead ankles frozen like pig iron. Can't even get the shoes off.
哟，这白毛小子怀里还抱着把好刀，拿去能换两斗粟米！: Look at this white-haired kid clutching a fine blade! That's two measures of millet.
（杜五伸出三根指头的左手去掰刀柄，被刘白猛地攥住手腕）: (Du Wu reaches with his three-fingered hand. Liu Bai seizes his wrist.)
（刘白惊醒，摸向腰间，抓了个空）: (Liu Bai jolts awake and reaches for her belt. Her hand closes on air.)
松手。肋骨断了三根，还想扎穿肺？: Let go. Three ribs broken. Want one through your lung?
在火堆边烤着呢！俺用板车把你从破庙雪窝里拖回来的！: Warming by the fire! I dragged you out of the temple snow on my cart.
先说好，俺本来是图你那把刀和衣裳，可不是白救你！: Mind, I was after the blade and the clothes. I don't save folks for free!
图刀？他拿两双死人鞋给老身当诊金，求我来给你接骨。: The blade? He paid me two pairs of dead men's shoes to set your bones.
俺那是怕他死车上晦气……来，先喝碗热汤暖暖身子。: Didn't want her dying on my cart. Bad luck... Here, have some hot broth.
（刘白偏过头避开碗沿，手掌死死抵住冰冷的砖墙）: (Liu Bai turns from the bowl and presses her palm hard against the cold brick.)
眼窝是滚炭烫烂的，青丝也是熬白的……好重的血债。: Hot coals burned your eyes out. Grief bleached the hair... That's some blood debt.
不喝就不喝呗……哎，小瞎子，你家住哪，叫啥名？: Fine, don't drink. Say, blind kid, where's home? What's your name?
得，往后俺就叫你白哥！这是村西破瓦窑，你安心养着。: Boss Bai, then! This old kiln's west of the village. Rest easy.
（刘白扶着砖墙一点点撑起身体，鲜血渗出刚缠好的麻布）: (Liu Bai pushes herself up along the wall. Blood stains the fresh bandages.)
石雷还在破庙。刀给我。: Shi Lei's still at the ruined temple. Give me my blade.
白哥你不要命了？！外头全是黄巾贼，你连站都站不稳！: Got a death wish, Boss Bai? Yellow Turbans everywhere, and you can barely stand!
把刀给她吧。心口憋着那口死气，拦在窑里也是憋死。: Give her the blade. What's eating her alive will kill her here too.
……债我活着回来还。: ...I'll come back alive and pay you.
（破庙大门再次被踹碎，风雪卷着血腥气灌入大殿）: (The gate shatters again. Wind drives snow and the smell of blood into the temple.)
来人！都死哪去了？！: Men! Where the hell are you?!
都先去阎王那等你了。: Waiting for you at death's gate.
疯子……文家打铁的早死绝了，怎会留你这么个索命鬼！: Madwoman... The Wen smiths are dead. Who left you alive to haunt me?
少装神弄鬼！老子能砸死你一回，就能砸死第二回！: Enough tricks! I crushed you once. I'll do it again!
（铜杖崩断落地，刘白一脚踩住石雷胸口，刀尖抵住他咽喉）: (The bronze staff snaps. Liu Bai pins Shi Lei down, steel at his throat.)
饶、饶命……踹翻锻炉的是阎虎！烫瞎你的炉灰真不是我泼的！: M-mercy... Yan Hu kicked the forge over! I never threw the ash in your eyes!
我爹打的那三十把刀，在哪。: The thirty blades my father forged. Where are they?
在洛阳！阎虎投了西凉董卓的飞熊军，刀全运进洛阳城了！: Luoyang! Yan Hu joined Dong Zhuo's Flying Bears and took the blades with him!
我腰里这把还你，求你留我一条狗命……别、别！: Take the one at my belt. Just let me live... No! No!
（刘白抓起滚烫的香炉灰按进他眼窝，顺势一刀封喉）: (Liu Bai presses hot ash into his eyes and cuts his throat.)
（殿内重归死寂，刘白解下石雷腰间的文家刀，独立风雪中）: (Silence. Liu Bai takes the Wen blade from Shi Lei's belt and stands alone in the snow.)
……阿爹，三十把刀，我拿回第一把了。: ...Father. Thirty blades. I got the first one back.
可为什么杀了他，眼里还是这么黑。: Why is it still so dark?
死人堆里刨了半宿，你手冰凉，吓死俺了。: Dug half the night through bodies. Your hands were ice. Scared me witless.
满地死人，就你一个还攥着刀不撒手。: Bodies everywhere. You were the only one still gripping a blade.
别瞪俺，俺就是顺路捡鞋。: Don't glare. I was just picking up shoes.
先别说话，嘴里全是血沫子。: Don't speak yet. Your mouth's full of blood.
灰驴老远就闻出你了，直打响鼻。: The donkey smelled you from way off. Kept snorting.
衣裳又叫人劈烂了……俺缝得丑，将就穿。: They hacked your clothes to bits again. My stitches are ugly, but they'll hold.
打不过就跑，白哥，命比刀金贵！: If you can't win, run, Boss Bai. Your life is worth more than steel!
头发全冻在血泥里了，俺给你擦擦。: Your hair's frozen into bloody mud. Here, let me wipe it.
再偏半寸，喉管就断了。阎王都嫌你命苦。: Half an inch more and your throat was gone. Even death takes pity on you.
杜五哭着把你背进来，老身草席都备好了。: Du Wu carried you in crying. I'd already laid out a mat.
咬住木棍。肩膀脱了，我给你推回去。: Bite the stick. Shoulder's out. I'm putting it back.
流了半盆血，手冷得跟窑外的砖似的。: Half a basin of blood. Your hands are cold as the bricks outside.
十八岁的姑娘，刀口比死囚还多。: Eighteen, and more cuts on you than a condemned prisoner.
喝了这碗，睡一觉，明天接着找死。: Drink. Sleep. Go looking for death again tomorrow.
针还扎着呢，别大口喘气。: The needles are still in. Small breaths.
药钱记墙上了。死在外头，就拿刀抵。: I marked the bill on the wall. If you die out there, I take the blade.
这两根指头？饥荒那年抢麦饼，叫人剁了。: These two fingers? Lost them grabbing a flatbread in the famine.
那片麦子烧了三天三夜，俺就在边上看着。: That wheat field burned for three days and nights. I stood there watching.
活人比死人狠。俺宁可跟死人打交道。: The living are crueler. Give me the dead any day.
白哥，你半夜磨刀那声……听着比风雪还冷。: Boss Bai, when you whet that blade at night... It sounds colder than the snow.
麦饼刚烘的，揣怀里，出刀时肚里不慌。: Fresh flatbread. Keep it in your coat. You'll fight better fed.
白哥年纪比俺还小，头发咋就全白了？: You're younger than me, Boss Bai. How'd your hair go all white?
俺攒了几个铜钱，等你砍完人，咱打壶酒。: I've saved a few coins. When you're done cutting people up, we'll buy some wine.
早去早回，俺在窑口等你。: Go quick and come back quick. I'll wait at the kiln door.
裹胸勒太紧，出刀换不上气。这窑里没人看。: Wraps that tight choke your breath when you draw. Nobody's watching here.
老身这只眼，是在宫里哭瞎的。你呢？: I cried this eye blind in the palace. What took yours?
杜五那傻小子，还当你是条好汉。: That fool Du Wu still thinks you're a fine young man.
嘴上说不喝外人的东西，倒记着杜五拿鞋换来的诊金。: You turn down a stranger's broth, but remember the shoes that paid my fee.
过来烤烤手。人是肉长的，刀可冻不坏。: Warm your hands. You're flesh and bone. Your blade won't freeze.
外头尸山血海，瞎着眼，倒少看点脏东西。: Bodies and blood outside. One less foul thing for blind eyes to see.
药在炭上煨着。苦，喝了能多熬半宿。: Medicine's on the coals. It's bitter. It'll buy you half a night.
去吧。灶上留了热水，回来洗洗身上的血。: Go on. Water's warm on the stove. Wash the blood off when you get back.
那人我喂了三天热汤。那夜，是他开的坞门。: I fed him hot broth for three days. That night, he opened the gate.
文皎死在那夜了。往后，只有刘白。: Wen Jiao died that night. There's only Liu Bai now.
抱着阿爹坐了一宿，落了一头雪，七年没化。: I held Father all night. The snow in my hair hasn't melted in seven years.
石雷，阎虎，封寒，周默。……手不能抖。: Shi Lei. Yan Hu. Feng Han. Zhou Mo... Steady hand.
杀了他，风雪也没停。: He's dead. The snow's still falling.
石雷，销了。阿爹，第一把。: Shi Lei, struck off. Father, the first blade.
白哥，挑一样揣上再走。: Pick something for the road, Boss Bai.
外头死人比活人多，俺别的不会，管饱。: More dead than living out there. All I can do is feed you.
空着肚子咋拼刀子？挑一样，驴车套好了。: How'll you fight on an empty belly? Choose something. The donkey's hitched up.
家底就这点了，别看俺，赶紧走吧。: That's all we've got. Quit looking at me. Get going.
收尸攒的铜钱，路上好打点。: Coins from burying bodies. They'll get you through.
这酒呛嗓子，闷一口，挨刀都不觉疼！: It'll burn going down. One gulp and you won't feel a blade!
忍着点，扎偏一寸可不怪我。: Hold still. If I miss by an inch, don't blame me.
坐稳了。这几针下去，鬼门关前也能抢回条命。: Sit still. These needles can snatch you from death's gate.
每局开局: At the start of each run,
致命伤时留三成血: Survive a fatal blow at 30% health.
每间开始: At the start of each room,
摸她怀里！肯定藏着干粮！: Search her coat! There's food on her!
少废话，先把袄子扒了！: Shut up and strip that coat!
（风雪骤急，刘白微偏下颌，按住刀镡）: (The snow thickens. Liu Bai tilts her chin, a hand on the guard.)
刀都晃出声了，拿稳点。: Your blades are rattling. Hold them steady.
……是你。那碗姜汤，我记得。: ...It's you. I remember that bowl of ginger soup.
七年前，寒山坞文家，三十柄百辟刀。: Seven years ago. The Wen smiths of Hanshan. Thirty tempered blades.
七年前，寒山坞，高炉。: Seven years ago. Hanshan. The furnace.
不喝拉倒……哎，小兄弟，你叫啥名？: Suit yourself... Hey, little brother, what's your name?
买刀偿命。出鞘吧。: You bought the blade. Pay with your life. Draw.
仇人都在眼前了，你的手为何在抖？: Your enemy stands before you. Why does your hand shake?
他说娘是从崔府逃出来的乐伎……我不信。: He said Mother was a musician who fled the Cui house... I don't believe it.
何方高人，竟能踏过火网登船？: Who walks through a net of fire to board my ship?
你下炉去陪她。: Go join her in the furnace.
你听得出刀声，却听不出人心。: You can hear a blade. You can't hear a heart.
你把散在天下的四把刀，都替我收回来了。: You gathered the four scattered blades for me.
你骨子里流着他的血……崔玄是你的亲生父亲！: His blood is in your bones... Cui Xuan is your father!
俺那是怕死窑里晦气！来，喝碗热汤暖暖身子。: I just didn't want a corpse in my kiln! Here, hot soup.
先说好，俺本来图你这身行头，可不是白救你！: Let's be clear. I was after your clothes. I didn't save you for free!
凭你现在这副烂身子，连崔府的高墙都翻不过去。: In this state you couldn't even climb the Cui house wall.
初雪那天留你一命……不全是为了借刀杀人。: I spared you that first snow... not only to use your blade.
别乱动。肋骨断了三根，还想扎穿肺？: Don't move. Three ribs broken. Want one through your lung?
别叫这个名字。阿皎死在那夜了。: Don't call me that. Jiao died that night.
别扑腾，肋骨断了三根。: Stop thrashing. Three ribs are broken.
剩下的刀，都在许都。: The rest of the blades are in Xudu.
原来文冶还留了骨血。刀在我这。: So Wen Ye left a child behind. The blades are with me.
只剩最底下这一个。: Only the one at the bottom is left.
可为什么杀了他，心里还是这么冷。: Then why am I still this cold after killing him?
可阿皎，你的名字，是我当年起的。: But Jiao... I gave you that name.
各为其主罢了。既然寻来，便在此了结。: We each served a master. You came this far. It ends here.
名单上那些拿刀的恶鬼，你够得着的，先去杀。: The devils on that list with the blades. Kill the ones you can reach first.
周默在乌林水寨……去吧，去替崔家卖命……: Zhou Mo is at the Wulin river camp... Go. Do the Cui house's work...
周默，销了。阿爹，第四把。: Zhou Mo, crossed out. Father, the fourth.
咳……丫头，你可知当年崔长史下的什么令？: Cough... Girl, do you know what order the Chief Clerk gave?
咳……你以为这七年，我们为何四散逃命？: Cough... Why do you think we scattered and ran these seven years?
咳……你真当她是铁匠的浑家？！: Cough... You really think she was the smith's wife?!
哟，这白毛小子怀里还死死抱着把亮钢刀！: Look, this white-haired kid is hugging a bright steel blade!
哪来的白发瞎子，也配拿这等亮钢百辟刀？: A blind white-haired nobody, carrying a tempered blade like that?
哪来的野狗，敢闯西凉军的铸钱地界？: What stray dares walk into the Xiliang army's mint?
四个名字都划了。: All four names are crossed out.
图行头？他拿两双死人鞋当诊金，求我来接骨。: Your clothes? He paid me two pairs of dead men's shoes to set your bones.
在火堆边烤着呢！俺从崔府后沟把你拖回来的！: Drying by the fire! I dragged you out of the ditch behind the Cui house!
外头乱军已破城……你真不杀我？: The rebels have broken the city... You really won't kill me?
夜深落了锁。你走错门了。: The gates are locked this late. You came to the wrong door.
大雪封路冻死这么些，倒叫俺捡了便宜。: The snow froze so many on the road. Lucky for me.
天下第一铁匠的拇指，泡在药酒里，完好如初。: The finest smith's thumb, kept in medicinal wine. Good as new.
她是崔府逃出来的乐伎！进坞前肚子就大了！: She was a musician who fled the Cui house! She was with child before she reached Hanshan!
姑奶奶饶命！……阎虎在洛阳铸钱场熔铜！: Mercy! ...Yan Hu is melting bronze at the Luoyang mint!
姑娘这寸口沉涩……脉象倒像一位许都故人。: Your pulse is heavy, girl... It reminds me of someone in Xudu.
封寒在下邳……别割头，留我个全尸……: Feng Han is in Xiapi... Not my head. Leave me whole...
封寒，销了。阿爹，第三把。: Feng Han, crossed out. Father, the third.
崔、崔府那位竟放你出来？……那他留你有用！: The Cui house let you go? ...Then he's keeping you for something!
崔府后沟这死人，脚冻得生硬，鞋扒不下来。: This corpse in the Cui ditch is frozen stiff. The shoes won't come off.
崔玄……你造的孽，自己来还。: Cui Xuan... You'll answer for what you did yourself.
崔玄在司空府。刀给我，我要回去。: Cui Xuan is in the Minister's house. Give me my blade. I'm going back.
崔长史要灭口……你杀的每一个，都在替他收账！: The Chief Clerk wants us silenced... Every one you kill settles his debts!
当年老子一脚踹翻锻炉，没把你的骨头烫化？: I kicked that forge over. It didn't melt your bones?
得，往后叫你白哥！这是破瓦窑，你安心养着。: Fine, Boss Bai it is! This is an old kiln. Rest easy.
我一勺一勺，喂了你三碗热姜汤。: I fed you three bowls of ginger soup, spoon by spoon.
我阿爹的右手大指，你收在哪。: My father's right thumb. Where do you keep it?
抬去后门扔进乱葬沟。: Carry her out the back gate. Throw her in the ditch.
拔刀吧。让我看看文冶教了你几成。: Draw. Show me how much Wen Ye taught you.
拿刀的那四个人你一个都没杀过，就来找我？: You haven't killed even one of the four with the blades, and you come for me?
指头还来。头留下。: Give back the finger. Leave the head.
挥刀封喉，独入风雪: Cut his throat, walk into the snow alone
救了一条恶犬，拆了我家的门。: I saved a vicious dog, and it tore down my door.
文家？哈！风箱底下那只缩头小耗子？！: The Wens? Ha! That little mouse under the bellows?!
斩断恩仇，抱刀归窑: Cut every tie, carry the blades home
是。我做的事，从不辩解。: Yes. I never explain what I do.
替他收账？……我自会去收他的命。: Settle his debts? ...I'll settle his life.
替崔府灭口……究竟谁在算计谁？: Silencing for the Cui house... Who is using whom?
松手……娘哎，怎么还有气儿？！: Let go... Oh, Ma, still breathing?!
白哥……不，姑娘，快坐这烤烤火！: Boss Bai... no, miss. Sit by the fire!
白哥！俺温了热酒，快进窑烤烤！: Boss Bai! I warmed some wine. Come in by the fire!
眼眶烫烂了，心没烂。过来喝口热汤吧。: Your eyes are burned. Your heart isn't. Come have some soup.
眼窝是滚炭烫烂的，青丝也是熬白的……好重的债。: Eyes burned by coals, hair gone white... What a debt.
瞎眼的女娃，你的血也配入我的药炉。: Blind girl, even your blood is fit for my furnace.
石雷，阎虎，封寒，周默，崔玄。……手不能抖。: Shi Lei. Yan Hu. Feng Han. Zhou Mo. Cui Xuan. ...My hand can't shake.
第三把刀收回来了。阿爹的手指也回来了。: The third blade is back. So is Father's finger.
老子亲手推进去的，烧得可旺了！: I pushed her in myself. She burned bright!
还有封寒，周默，崔玄。: Still Feng Han, Zhou Mo, Cui Xuan.
这些刀留给你。我只带阿爹那一把。: Keep these blades. I take only Father's.
这把刀，该归位了。: This blade goes back where it belongs.
连那贱婢和野种，一起烧干净！: The slave girl and her bastard too. Burn them all!
那夜寒山坞三十一条人命，也是你下的令。: Thirty-one lives at Hanshan that night. Your order too.
那年冬天，你在坞外雪地倒了三天。: That winter you lay in the snow outside Hanshan for three days.
那日他放过你……是借你的刀，杀干净我们四个……: He let you go that day... to use your blade on the four of us...
那条我救活的狗，该还债了。: The dog I saved owes me a debt.
阎虎，销了。阿爹，第二把。: Yan Hu, crossed out. Father, the second.
阿娘是阿爹的妻。你骗不了我。: Mother was Father's wife. You can't fool me.
阿爹，三十柄刀，我收回第一把了。: Father, thirty blades. I have the first back.
阿爹，我只有你一个爹。: Father, you are my only father.
雪把血盖住了。天地间，再没人能看见。: The snow covers the blood. No one in the world can see it now.
高炉？……哈！铁匠那个细皮嫩肉的婆娘？: The furnace? ...Ha! The smith's soft-skinned woman?
（一刀了断，刘白背着一捆刀，迎着残雪走回破窑）: (One cut ends it. Liu Bai carries a bundle of blades back to the kiln through the snow.)
（三十柄百辟刀依次挂满木架，寒芒映透昏暗窑洞）: (Thirty tempered blades fill the rack. Their cold light fills the dark kiln.)
（从柜底取回第三柄文家刀，刀锋在水光下泛白）: (She takes the third Wen blade from the cabinet. Its edge pales in the water light.)
（刀光决绝划过咽喉，热血喷溅雪地，刘白未吐一字）: (The blade crosses his throat. Blood sprays the snow. Liu Bai says nothing.)
（刀光抹过咽喉，阎虎尸身滚入炉灰池中）: (The blade crosses his throat. Yan Hu rolls into the ash pit.)
（刀锋擦着他的皮肉停住，刘白收刀入鞘）: (The edge stops against his skin. Liu Bai sheathes her blade.)
（刘白偏头避开破碗，掌心死死顶住冰冷窑砖）: (Liu Bai turns from the chipped bowl, palm pressed hard to the cold kiln brick.)
（刘白在两人中间慢慢坐下）: (Liu Bai slowly sits down between them.)
（刘白在断碑上划下最后一道，抬手解下蒙眼布）: (Liu Bai cuts the last stroke on the stele, then unties her blindfold.)
（刘白惊醒摸向腰间，指尖抓空）: (Liu Bai wakes and reaches for her belt. Her hand closes on air.)
（刘白扶墙撑起身体）: (Liu Bai pushes herself up against the wall.)
（刘白扶墙撑起身体，鲜血渗透刚敷好的草药）: (Liu Bai pushes up against the wall. Blood soaks through the fresh poultice.)
（刘白抓起滚烫炉灰按进他眼眶，翻腕一刀封喉）: (Liu Bai presses hot ash into his eyes, then turns her wrist and cuts his throat.)
（刘白抽刀割喉，将朱漆匣小心收入怀中）: (Liu Bai cuts his throat and tucks the red lacquer box into her coat.)
（刘白拇指顶开刀镡，长刀发出极细铁鸣）: (Liu Bai thumbs the guard open. The blade gives a thin ring.)
（刘白拾起炉边第二柄文家刀，指尖微颤）: (Liu Bai picks up the second Wen blade by the furnace. Her fingers tremble.)
（刘白握住第四柄百辟刀，身形在浓烟中摇晃）: (Liu Bai grips the fourth tempered blade, swaying in the smoke.)
（刘白沉肩，刀身在热风里低低一鸣）: (Liu Bai lowers her shoulder. The blade hums in the hot wind.)
（刘白没有回头，一步一步走入人间战火与风霜）: (Liu Bai does not look back. Step by step, she walks into war and frost.)
（刘白没有回头，抱紧佩刀，走向茫茫雪野深处）: (Liu Bai does not look back. Holding her blade close, she walks deep into the snowfield.)
（刘白独自走回破瓦窑外，在残碑上划下深深刻痕）: (Liu Bai walks back to the kiln alone and cuts a deep mark into the stele.)
（刘白踏着风雪走进破庙，指尖搭在刀柄上）: (Liu Bai walks into the ruined temple through the snow, fingers on the hilt.)
（大钺脱手，刘白一刀斩断阎虎右臂）: (The axe flies loose. Liu Bai takes off Yan Hu's right arm.)
（大雪纷纷扬扬落下，将满地殷红尽数掩盖）: (Heavy snow falls and covers all the red.)
（她从壁上摘下一柄，转身跨出门槛）: (She takes one blade from the wall and steps out over the threshold.)
（封寒阴笑一声，自怀中取出一方朱漆小匣）: (Feng Han chuckles and draws a small red lacquer box from his coat.)
（崔玄从壁上掣下佩刀，刀光如秋水映雪）: (Cui Xuan pulls a blade from the wall. It gleams like still water against snow.)
（崔玄单手振刀，清越龙吟撕裂风雪）: (Cui Xuan snaps the blade one-handed. Its ring cuts through the storm.)
（崔玄屈膝跪地，百辟刀刃稳稳架在他颈侧皮肉上）: (Cui Xuan kneels. The tempered edge rests steady against his neck.)
（崔玄扫雪的手一顿，抬头看她蒙眼的红布）: (Cui Xuan's broom stops. He looks up at her red blindfold.)
（崔玄推开廊门，从兵器架上取下一柄亮钢长刀）: (Cui Xuan opens the gallery door and takes a bright steel blade from the rack.)
（崔玄蹲下伸手，指尖停在覆眼布前，终是收回）: (Cui Xuan crouches and reaches out. His fingers stop at her blindfold, then draw back.)
（府门轰然碎裂，叛军厮杀声排山倒海涌入）: (The gate bursts. The roar of rebel fighting floods in.)
（断剑坠入火海，周默被刀刃贯穿胸膛，倚着船舷）: (The broken sword falls into the fire. Run through, Zhou Mo slumps against the rail.)
（更深雪重，刘白翻墙落进前庭，廊下有人在扫雪）: (Deep night, heavy snow. Liu Bai drops over the wall. Under the eaves, someone is sweeping.)
（杜五伸手去掰刀柄，被刘白猛地攥住手腕）: (Du Wu reaches for the hilt. Liu Bai grabs his wrist.)
（火浪扑面，刘白一刀封喉，任由尸体滑入烈火）: (Fire rolls over them. Liu Bai cuts his throat and lets the body slide into the flames.)
（炉里铜汁翻滚，热浪夹着焦臭，阎虎提钺回身）: (Molten bronze churns. Through the hot stench, Yan Hu turns with his axe.)
（烈火烧天，战船断裂哀鸣，周默扶旗按剑而立）: (The sky burns. Warships groan apart. Zhou Mo stands by the banner, hand on sword.)
（药库阴湿，药味刺鼻，封寒枯手搭在刘白手腕上）: (The storeroom is damp and reeks of herbs. Feng Han's bony hand rests on her wrist.)
（药柜崩裂，封寒被一刀贯胸，钉在柜门上）: (The cabinet bursts. Run through, Feng Han is pinned to its door.)
（藏刀阁四壁如洗，二十六柄亮钢百辟刀森然列阵）: (The vault walls are bare but for twenty-six bright tempered blades in rows.)
（血溅雪地，刘白拔出石雷腰间的百辟刀）: (Blood on the snow. Liu Bai draws the tempered blade from Shi Lei's belt.)
（铜杖断裂，刘白踩住石雷心口，刀锋压上咽喉）: (The bronze staff snaps. Liu Bai pins Shi Lei's chest, edge to his throat.)
（长刀脱手飞插雪地，刘白呕血跪倒，指骨抠进冻土）: (Her blade flies into the snow. Liu Bai coughs blood and falls to her knees, fingers in frozen earth.)
（风雪自破碎的阁门呼啸灌入，霜刃悬在毫厘之间）: (Snow howls through the broken door. The frosted edge hangs a hair away.)
